_comment: gap-G4-codex-fetch-stage-recall spec 2(b): hand-paraphrased queries, keyed by conversation_id, consumed by examples/probe_codex_recall.rs --paraphrases. Every entry is a reformulation of the conversation's own real first message (never the harness-boilerplate proxy) — deliberately reworded so it shares no long verbatim run with the source chunk (enforced at load time by shares_long_ngram(_, _, 8) in the probe). The 11 codex:* entries whose id appears in the wpa-recall-sample-v1 --sample 20 selection are exercised directly by the probe's default run; the remaining 9 codex entries and all 20 claude entries widen coverage for other seeds/sample sizes and satisfy the spec's >=20/>=20 floor.
